title: Personalisation sign inversion
finding: tooHard lowers score, while the ranker gives lower score higher priority. This contradicts fitness_model.dart's stated recovery/downweight semantics.
required_action: Do not migrate this formula into Recommendation Engine. Split tolerance/recovery signal from training priority and add regression tests.

title: LLM owns unvalidated starting-load guidance
finding: Cloud AI is explicitly asked for beginner volume and an exercise starting-load cue, with no deterministic prescription validator.
required_action: Remove numeric prescription authority from AI Coach before Recommendation Engine release.

title: Clinical safety inputs are collected but not generally enforced
finding: HealthHistory contains conditions, medications, limitations, surgeries, blood pressure and concerns; production recommendation safety primarily screens Injury objects.
required_action: Add a centralized SafetyGate. Raw medication strings may not be classified by model memory.

title: AI Planner / onboarding preview ignore equipment availability
finding: Candidate pools include bodyweight plus every equipment's exercises. buildPlan filters injuries but does not consume EquipmentAccess/location.
required_action: Route through centralized eligibility before ranking.

title: Home Suggestions ignore EquipmentAccess
finding: Home uses forYouExercisesProvider; it injury-screens and tier-sorts but does not apply availableWith(profile.equipment).

title: Exact-kg progression is a hard-coded heuristic
finding: UI directly surfaces kg from fixed -5%, +5%, +2.5/+1.25 rules, default 8 reps and default compound=true.
required_action: Replace with load/progression engine using history quality, target effort, load context, staleness and equipment increments.

title: Isolation increment is destroyed by rounding grid
finding: The 1.25kg isolation increment is passed through a global nearest-2.5kg rounder.
required_action: Rounding must be equipment-context-specific and applied after a valid target is calculated.

title: Legacy history view loses set-level information
finding: asLogEntries emits one compatibility row per exercise using only its last set. A progression engine cannot infer full performance from this view.
required_action: New engine reads WorkoutSession / per-set data directly.

title: Performed-set model lacks effort and load context
finding: SetCapture only stores weightKg/reps; no RIR/RPE, equipment instance/load context, or recommendation link.
required_action: Add backward-compatible performed-set/context fields in a dedicated migration gate.

title: Programme schedule is exercise-duration rotation, not prescription
finding: The schedule stores exercises and duration but no sets/reps/effort/load prescription; current rows use uniform 10-minute exercise durations per generator comments.
required_action: Add an optional prescription snapshot to scheduled sessions without breaking old documents.

title: Recovery detector conflates adherence with physiological recovery
finding: Missed scheduled sessions are one of the deload signals; HRV is not currently wired; a fixed 0.5 factor scales scheduled duration.
required_action: Split readiness/recovery from adherence and from dose adaptation.

title: Set timer presets can be mistaken for prescription
finding: Tier-based fixed work/rest/set presets are useful timer defaults but are not goal-specific training prescription.
required_action: Keep as UX preset or make it consume engine prescription; label policy class explicitly.

title: Loaded-equipment whitelist is incomplete by construction
finding: exerciseUsesLoad uses a fixed whitelist; unknown equipment defaults to no load capture.
required_action: Move load semantics to exercise/equipment recommendation metadata while retaining conservative fallback.

title: Documentation drift
finding: Historical counts/capabilities differ across docs; current code must be source of truth for implementation.
required_action: Update CODEMAP/CONVENTIONS in the same commit when Recommendation Engine feature is added.

title: Cold-start safety screening is fail-closed
finding: screeningProfileProvider awaits auth and profile instead of treating AsyncLoading as no profile.

title: Sensitive health profile is device-local
finding: DeviceHealthProfileRepository merges local sensitive data with Firestore profile.
required_action: Engine consumes merged provider; never bypass it with direct Firestore reads.

title: Scanner has explicit uncertainty states
finding: The scanner distinguishes alternatives/unknown/failure and deliberately distrusts high-confidence offline results.

title: Form Check says cannot-tell instead of inventing faults
finding: Pose gate separates unscorable frames from bad form.
required_action: Use only validated observable signals; no diagnosis/injury-risk claims.
